text:
Riley: Tiny whimsy question for the room  if you could legally change your middle name to a single word that describes your 2026 energy, what would it be? :sparkles:
Sam: "Buffer"  because I'm holding all the chaos at arm's length.
Noor: "Cursor"  always ready to move, blink, edit.
Diego: "Espresso"  loud, short, and gets things done. :coffee:
bot-snacks: Reminder: Friday snack run at 15:30. Vote :one: savory :two: sweet
Riley: Bonus: if you pick someone else's middle-name suggestion for yourself, they owe you a small favour.
Sam: I nominate Noor's "Cursor" for my new email signature.
Noor: Trade: Diego owes me a latte if he convinces legal to accept "Espresso".
Diego: Deal. Will provide espresso-themed affidavit.
Riley: Poll time: react with :one: Buffer :two: Cursor :three: Espresso :four: something weirder
Sam: :one: (buffering is a lifestyle)
Noor: :two:
Diego: :three:
Riley: Also accept wild entries. If you want to be dramatic: "Thunderclap". If you want zen: "Bamboo".
Sam: Would the HR form accept "Bamboo" followed by an asterisk with explanatory footnote?
Noor: "Cursor* (blinks with purpose)". Footnote is mandatory.
Diego: I will autograph a print that says "Diego Espresso" for whoever helps me change it.
Riley: Best extra-weird name wins a miniature plastic trophy (virtual). Drop your last-minute ideas.
